title: rosa flexuosa subsp. pugetii
intro: Rosa flexuosa subsp. pugetii, commonly known as the Pacific rose or Puget's rose, is a fragrant and flowering shrub native to the Pacific Northwest region of North America. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, and its therapeutic actions may help to soothe digestive issues, reduce fever, and alleviate respiratory problems. The bioactive constituents of Rosa flexuosa subsp. pugetii include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are believed to contribute to its medicinal properties. Further research is needed to fully understand the extent of its health benefits and therapeutic actions.
